addr: 4th Floor, 67, 6th B Main Rd, Dollar Layout, 3rd Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t: Went for dinner here on a Friday night and surprisingly very little crowd. The food was great taste wise and service was good. The drinks were decent too. The ambience is very beautiful, but it would have been lively with better music and more crowd. It has a more romantic setting. Valet Parking available.
